title: A/B vs Shadow Deployments in MLOps

scenes.line1: How do you test new models
scenes.say: How do you safely test a new machine learning model in production, without risking user experience?

left.title: A/B
items: Each group gets a model version

scenes.say: There are two main approaches. With A/B deployment, users are split and each group gets a different model version. With shadow deployment, the new model runs in parallel, but only logs predictions without affecting users.

rows.b: Half get version one, half get two

scenes.say: For example, in A/B, half your users see the old model, half see the new one. In shadow, the new model makes predictions, but they're just logged for analysis.

scenes.question: Which is safer for new models?
scenes.right: Shadow, since users never see results
scenes.say: Here's a common interview trap. Which method is safer for testing a brand new model? It's shadow deployment, since users never see its predictions.
